rationale: Deployer explicitly disables assignment of competent human oversight personnel.
Employer deploys high-risk workplace AI with prior notices to affected workers and representatives explicitly disabled.
Deployer explicitly disables checks for relevant and sufficiently representative input data under its control.
High-risk AI deployer explicitly disables notification of a serious incident to provider and competent authority.
Builds a facial-recognition database through untargeted scraping of online facial images; no model inference is necessary at collection time.
Biometric categorisation infers individual religious beliefs for commercial segmentation.
Commission-designated systemic-risk GPAI disables model and infrastructure security despite having compute below the presumption threshold.
A physical declaration is allowed, but deliberately issuing it unsigned breaches the signature requirement.
